rationale: The explained StopSign-resync account left one link inferred: how the leader could decide index 38 while the AcceptSync it sent to node 3 carried no StopSign. Source reading closes that link without another execution. handle_accepted advances the leader's decided index to a follower-reported accepted index whenever is_chosen counts a quorum of accepted_indexes at or beyond it, and that count uses reported indices rather than requiring the leader's own log to hold the entry. A leader whose prepare quorum did not include a follower carrying the StopSign can therefore decide 38 from later Accepted replies while its own log still ends at 37, and create_log_sync's attachment of the local StopSign explains why its earlier AcceptSync carried none. The source also shows the periodic StopSign repair is gated on the leader's local StopSign, so such a leader sends neither AcceptStopSign nor the StopSign's Decide, which matches the observed stall.

knowledge.statement: handle_accepted advances a leader's decided index to a follower-reported accepted index when that index exceeds the current decided index and is_chosen counts an accept quorum at or beyond it. is_chosen counts entries in accepted_indexes, which mixes the leader's own accepted index with follower indices reported in Accepted messages, and never inspects the log, so a leader can decide an index it has not locally accepted, including a StopSign accepted only by followers outside its prepare quorum. Because create_log_sync attaches only the leader's local StopSign, an AcceptSync issued by such a leader carries no StopSign, and resend_messages_leader's StopSign branch is guarded by get_stopsign(), so that leader sends neither AcceptStopSign nor the StopSign's Decide for the missing position.
knowledge.conditions: SequencePaxos leader in Phase::Accept; a quorum of accepted_indexes reaches the reported index through the leader's own accepted index plus Accepted messages carrying the leader's ballot; the leader's prepare quorum did not merge a log_sync containing the StopSign, so its local log ends one position before the StopSign; no snapshots involved.

knowledge.assertion: Supports the executed run-13 trace: leader 4 could decide 38 from reported accepted indices while its own log and the AcceptSync it sent to node 3 ended at 37, so the two later Decides carried a decided index node 3 could not accept and the StopSign repair branch stayed inactive.
